_comment: An example scene. 22 entities and 3 different images. The eighteen asteroids all use the same picture, so it is loaded once and shared - open the Inspector on one of them and look at how many things are sharing it.
_hierarchy_note: SolarRoot -> Planet -> Moon is three levels deep on purpose. Only the root, the planet and the moon have a SpinComponent; the orbiting is produced entirely by the parent/child transform tree.
_motion_note: SolarRoot spins, so Planet - its child, 160 units out - ORBITS the origin. Planet spins, so Moon orbits the Planet and the Planet visibly turns. Moon spins backwards on its own axis. There is no orbit code anywhere: a child's position in the world is worked out through its parent, so spinning a parent sweeps its children round with it. All of it comes from this file.
